entities.summary: Jaden Tyree Springer is an American professional basketball player who last played for the New Orleans Pelicans of the NBA. He played college basketball for the Tennessee Volunteers. Springer was drafted by the Philadelphia 76ers in 2021. As a reserve with the 2023–24 Boston Celtics, Springer won an NBA championship.
